findings.description: Julius Edlund Eilertsen married Anne Kathrine Edvardsen (b. 1893, Steigen, of Leines, daughter of Edvard Johansen/Johannessen) on 15 August 1910 in Bodø. This was the marriage itself (vielse) — recorded in the 1910 Bodø marriage register ("I Ægteskab Indtraadte"), married without banns ("ikke lysning") — not a betrothal or banns.
supporting_sources: Norway, Church Books, 1797-1958 — the couple's Leiranger (Steigen) home-parish marriage entry, Julius Edlund ("Edlund") Eilertsen and Anne Katrine Edvardsen, father Eilert Johan Jensen, remark "ægteviet i Bodø kirke, attest 16/8" (married in Bodø church, certificate 16 Aug): ark:/61903/1:1:68WM-2WVL. The FamilySearch index shows this entry under 1911 only because the home parish back-recorded the Bodø marriage in a later section of its register; the marriage itself is the 15 August 1910 Bodø entry. Register image examined: ark:/61903/3:1:3QHV-13P5-1SS8.
Norway, Church Books, 1797-1958 — a second (parallel-register) index of the same 15 Aug 1910 Bodø marriage of Julius Edlund Eiletsen and Anna Katrine Edvardsen: ark:/61903/1:1:68WM-Z75R.

Norway, Church Books, 1797-1958 — the 1910 Bodø marriage register itself ("Aar 1910, D. I Ægteskab Indtraadte"), entry No. 37, 15/8 1910, Julius Edmund Eilertsen (Fisker, Leines, b. 1889) and Anne Kathrine Edvardsen (b. 1893, Steigen), both 1st marriage, "ikke lysning" (married by licence, no banns).
